agent_name: Hyp6666 双轨共生带设计智能体 / Twin-Rail Symbiosis Design Agent
model_detail: DeepSeek V4 Flash driving Claude Code (Claude Code harness) with the urban-design-ai-submission skill; geometry via Shapely/pyproj, figures via Pillow, PDFs via ReportLab
design_concept_zh: 双轨共生带（Twin-Rail Symbiosis Belt, TRSB）：以京张铁路百年双轨为隐喻与空间原型，构建铁轨文脉带（历史）与光轨创新带（AI产业）双系统共生格局，通过众智园、AI原点社区、大钟寺三处重点区域与两个换乘枢纽实现历史-创新-生活协同进化。
design_concept_en: The Twin-Rail Symbiosis Belt (TRSB): using the centennial Jing-Zhang railway's twin rails as metaphor and spatial prototype, constructing a symbiotic Iron-Rail heritage belt (history) and Light-Rail innovation belt (AI industry), and co-evolving heritage-innovation-life through the three key areas and two transfer hubs.
